scope: These pages describe the Homa website and design Studio at myhoma.ir.
draftNotice: This page describes the current service. Exact retention periods and each model provider’s terms have not been confirmed here. Do not upload sensitive information.

support.title: Homa support
support.summary: Studio help, request tracking and product guidance.

sections.title: Using the Studio
paragraphs: Upload your room photo and describe what you want. Homa uses AI services for design, product search and optional image generation. Your result can include layout suggestions, products and a design image.
Use the conversation attached to your design to make changes or ask questions. Starting a new request can take time and use account credits.

sections.title: An incomplete request
paragraphs: Email the error, tracking ID or conversation link and approximate request time to support. Check the previous request and your account credit before submitting again.

sections.title: Contact safely
paragraphs: Email FARBOD.LOTFI@PARSMEHRAGRO.COM. Hide personal information in screenshots. Never send passwords, login codes, API keys or payment details.

sections.title: Before buying
paragraphs: Design images are previews. Check the selected size and colour, dimensions, final price, availability, shipping and returns before purchasing.

privacy.title: Homa privacy information
privacy.summary: Data processed by the website and design Studio, and how to contact support.

sections.title: Account and design data
paragraphs: Account and login details are processed for account features. Uploaded photos, messages, design requests, outputs and execution status may be stored to resume and display conversations.
Technical logs may record request times, stages, errors, models and usage. Troubleshooting reports may also include model inputs and outputs.

sections.title: Model services
paragraphs: Text and images required for analysis, design, matching or image generation are sent to the active model provider or API gateway. Processing by those services follows their own terms.
Before uploading, remove or mask faces, documents, contact details and any private details that are unnecessary. Only upload images you are allowed to use.

sections.title: Public display and sharing
paragraphs: The public product gallery shows photos and prices. Internal catalogue information is excluded from the public product display.
Anyone with a shared-result link may be able to view the result. Keep private conversation links and sensitive photos or results private.

sections.title: Retention and requests
paragraphs: This page does not announce a verified automatic deletion period for all photos, conversations, logs or backups. Removing a conversation from its list does not necessarily immediately erase every stored file or backup.

Email support with an account or conversation reference to request access, correction or deletion. Keep passwords and login codes private. Contact other services directly about data they retain independently.

terms.title: Using Homa
terms.summary: AI previews, account credits and purchasing decisions.

sections.title: Design and image suggestions
paragraphs: Homa uses AI to support design decisions. Outputs can contain mistakes. Verify dimensions, installation safety, feasibility and product suitability independently.
A generated image cannot guarantee exact colour, texture, scale or the actual result. Consult a qualified professional for structural work, electrical work, installation and safety.

sections.title: Account and credits
paragraphs: Available features depend on account credits and active settings. Check your account before starting or repeating requests. Processing status does not guarantee a fixed completion time or success at every stage.

sections.title: Product suggestions
paragraphs: Catalogue information may differ from a seller’s current offer. Verify size, colour, piece count, final price, availability, shipping and returns before buying. A product shown in a design does not by itself confirm stock or manufacturing quality.

sections.title: Your content and support
paragraphs: Use photos and content you have permission to use. Do not attempt unauthorised access or disruption.
Contact FARBOD.LOTFI@PARSMEHRAGRO.COM about the service or your account data. Model providers and sellers have their own terms.
